For use on pages about an item that appears in-game, where a real picture would be unnecessary (e.g. [[DF2012:Nail]])

==Examples==

<pre>{{item picture|A|3:0:0|The letter A}}</pre>
{{item picture|A|3:0:0|The letter A}}
{{clear}}

<pre>{{item picture|{{char|224}}|5:0:0|Intestines|float=left}}</pre>
{{item picture|{{char|224}}|5:0:0|Intestines|float=left}}
{{clear}}

<pre>{{item picture|{{char|253}}|7:0:1|Skull|align=left}}</pre>
{{item picture|{{char|253}}|7:0:1|Skull|align=left}}
{{clear}}
